description: The transcripts of Mohammed (the Quran speech to text data). No recipe reads them: the transcript table and the verses' text are inside a tar archive compressed with xz, which keepset does not read.
name: Mohammed transcripts

recipe.reason: Its transcript table (transcripts.tsv) and the text of every verse (all_ayat.json) are members of Quran_Speech_Dataset.tar.xz, a tar archive compressed as one xz stream, and keepset reads no xz compression (its archive kinds are plain, gzip and bzip2 files, tar archives with none of them or those two, zip archives and spreadsheets), so the recipe has nothing to select the table with.
